coverage_claim: WM-DAT-010 covers one governed time series or observation collection from identity and dimensional structure through observations, values, multi-time semantics, vintages, coverage, transformations, forecasts, provenance, quality, corrections, lifecycle, access, distributions and projections. Domain profiles, restricted ISO clauses and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a versioned series-definition and observation-collection aggregate. Individual observation, variable, sensor, procedure, feature, statistical unit, source dataset, processing run, release, audit and records masters remain independently identifiable.

decisions.concept: Series definition, collection and observation boundary
decisions.rationale: The series definition fixes semantic and dimensional structure, the collection governs membership and versions, and each observation is a separately qualified assertion.
No relation row is frozen; the parent signal grants no ownership, mutation or cascade authority.
Phenomenon, reference, validity, result, availability, release, revision, recorded, ingestion, transaction and knowledge times remain distinct and RFC 3339-qualified where represented as timestamps.
Observed, estimated, imputed, adjusted, nowcast, forecast and scenario values remain explicitly classified and provenance-qualified.
Missing, not applicable, suppressed, confidential, below detection, invalid, provisional and absent remain distinct states rather than overloaded nulls.

Aggregation, weighting, unit conversion, normalization, seasonal adjustment, revision, correction and restatement create explicit derived or successor assertions and never silently rewrite issued observations.
Validation, quality, anomaly, uncertainty, confidence and certification claims remain metric, method, scope, version, source and limitation qualified.
SDMX, OMS, SSN, RDF Data Cube, CF and FHIR are overlapping sector profiles. ISO claims are limited to public metadata and SSN ObservationCollection retains its published non-normative caveat.
Ingestion, imputation, recalculation, revision, suppression, publication, certification, unit change, access widening and physical disposition require accountable external authority.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison locally without tools or new research facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-DAT-010 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: no relation row is frozen and the WM-MAT-008 parent signal grants no approved ownership, mutation or cascade behavior.

Boundary hold: series definition, collection, observation, variable, sensor, procedure, feature, statistical unit, source dataset, processing run, release, audit and records must remain separate identities.
Temporal hold: phenomenon, reference, validity, result, availability, release, revision, recorded, ingestion, transaction and knowledge times must never be silently collapsed.
Meaning hold: observed, estimated, imputed, adjusted, nowcast, forecast and scenario values require explicit classification, source, method and uncertainty.
Authority hold: ingestion, imputation, recalculation, revision, suppression, publication, certification, unit change, access widening and records disposition require delegated authority.
Restricted-source hold: ISO 8601-1:2019 is used only from public scope and lifecycle metadata; access-restricted clauses were not inspected or inferred.
Profile hold: SSN ObservationCollection is non-normative in the cited edition, and SDMX, OMS, SSN, RDF Data Cube, CF and FHIR mappings require version pins, conformance tests and loss declarations.
Privacy hold: confidential, personal, embargoed, security-sensitive, fine-grained and reconstruction-capable observations require purpose-bound access and minimization.
deferred_research: Approve or reject the WM-MAT-008 relation and register Variable, Unit, Observation, Sensor, Procedure, Feature, Statistical Unit, Population, Source Dataset, Processing Run, Release, Audit and Records edges.
Create financial ticks, industrial telemetry, climate-grid, clinical observation, event-sourcing, stream-processing and jurisdiction-specific statistical profiles.
Conformance-test series keys, calendars, time axes, missing states, vintages, transformations, forecasts, quality flags and distributions against concrete engines and datasets.
Validate organization-specific ingestion, disclosure control, publication, certification, legal hold, retention and disposition policies.
Inspect licensed ISO requirements under authorized access before making clause-level conformance claims.
Obtain independent external review before promoting beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
